decision: Do not admit single-provider XRP price snapshots, unreconciled ETF cumulative flows, or broad macro fund-flow observations as directional features until timestamp, universe and causal-validation requirements are met. Enforce archive-policy counts against live immutable pointer counts.
rules: Every market observation records provider, capture timestamp, provider observation timestamp if exposed, instrument/venue universe, units and missingness.
ETF flow providers are not averaged when fund coverage, settlement windows, cumulative definitions or holdings universes differ.
The October 29 US ETF session close at 20:00 UTC precedes the first identified Binance XRP transfer at 20:05 UTC; ETF flow is pre-incident context, not incident response.
Macro event and weekly fund-flow observations remain context-only until a point-in-time walk-forward model establishes incremental predictive value beyond BTC/ETH and market-wide controls.
No directional forecast until fixed-horizon outcomes, immutable feature snapshots, baseline comparisons, calibration and shadow evaluation pass.

For v3 research ledgers, archive_policy arrays record_count/chunk_count, archive_shards_total and corresponding ledger_metrics must match authoritative archive_pointer totals; validator fails closed on mismatch.
